nodes.label: Phase 0 - Project bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Create a shared, multi-agent, spec-driven development environment before building features. Status: in progress.

nodes.label: Phase 1 - Production-oriented RAG
nodes.rationale: Target duration approximately one focused week; 16 ordered items from foundation to recruiter demo.

nodes.label: Dense vs sparse vs hybrid comparisons
Token-based size cap with embedding tokenizer
nodes.rationale: Replaces Spec 004's 2,000-character cap: the same character count means different token counts per language, and Malayalam uses more tokens per character than English.

nodes.label: Guard against silent truncation
nodes.rationale: sentence-transformers truncates silently, so count tokens before embedding and fail when a chunk exceeds the model's maximum sequence length.

nodes.label: Parent-heading context and order-independent section_ids
nodes.rationale: Addresses Spec 004 baseline limitations: duplicate-heading section_ids must not depend on order.

nodes.label: Prompt injection and poisoned retrieved content tests
Citation manipulation tests and input/cost limits
Spec 008 early delivery (D056)
nodes.rationale: Retrieval degradation was taken ahead of item 7; hybrid serves BM25 from local SQLite FTS5 when Qdrant or the embedding model is unreachable, and bm25 needs neither Qdrant nor the bge-m3 extra.

nodes.label: Deferred serving concerns (circuit breaker, startup policy, Qdrant 5xx D062)
nodes.rationale: Left to the HTTP route spec: a circuit breaker, a startup policy for a missing or stale lexical file, and Qdrant 5xx eligibility.

nodes.label: Docker, Terraform, EC2, ECR, CloudWatch, IAM, Bedrock
Evaluation Governance (keep/modify/deprecate/replace)
nodes.rationale: Nothing changes active evaluation truth without admin approval.

nodes.label: LLM suggestions (inactive until approved)
nodes.rationale: LLM output is candidate only; admin can accept, edit+accept, reject or manually create cases.

nodes.label: Agent capabilities only where they solve a real product problem
